items.title: David Weinstein Interview, 1988-09-22
items.q: I didn't get to meet Louis until, when would it have been, when I was with his brother Leon's band... And then Louis used to come around then and I got to know him.

ctx.x: Did you play in a school band too?

Well, I went to Warren Easton and Mike Capera was the music teacher out there. And at that time, he didn't like me at all. I should mention that. And when I came into a certain misfortune at one time, he read it out and practically told the class, see if you guys don't behave yourselves, you'll do the same thing. Let me deviate. This is another epic story in my life. For several years after World War I, November the 11th, almost this day, was a holiday. And this particular year, the school board and its wisdom…
They were all, for the most part, Warren Eastern people, weren't they? I would say yes, yes, yes, yes, yes. Did you know Sterling Bowles?
